class.name: ClippedVoxelGenerator4D
class.brief_description: A generator clipping a modifier generator to the shape of a base generator.
class.description: ClippedVoxelGenerator4D combines two generators: where the [member base] is undefined the result is undefined, and where it's defined, the [member modifier]'s material may replace it. The modifier's content is thus clipped to the defined shape of the base.

members.member: The generator whose defined region bounds the result. While unset, the result is undefined everywhere.
The generator overlaid inside the base's defined region.
